rationale: Resolve the ArcLight census holding Inspiration Mobility to the existing Inspiration Mobility Group platform rather than creating a duplicate. Retain Inspiration Mobility Group as the canonical display name and add the shorter operating name as an alias. Correct the existing ArcLight ownership period to the canonical ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P. record. Add Macquarie Asset Management and Ferrovial, S.A. as separately visible current equity investors based on the closed May 2022 capital raise and current investor and portfolio pages; retain null for undisclosed percentages and vehicles, while recording Ferrovial's publicly described minority position. Correct the inaccurately dated September 2024 milestone to the May 18, 2022 closing and attach direct evidence to all three existing milestones. Inspiration Fleet, Inspiration Energy and the acquired Electrada assets remain beneath the single platform boundary. ArcLight, Macquarie, Ferrovial and company materials support continuing ownership, and no Inspiration-specific sale or pending exit was identified through August 13, 2026. The reciprocal queue task for Inspiration Mobility Group will be superseded only after this task is released and production-verified; there is no second database company to merge or redirect.

beforeImage.name: Inspiration Mobility Group
beforeImage.description: Inspiration Mobility Group provides electric-vehicle infrastructure and fleet electrification solutions for commercial fleet operators. The platform serves customers that need vehicles, charging, and operating support, and its model combines service delivery with ownership and deployment of charging assets. At launch, the company announced a fleet partnership with Revel and an initial $200 million capital commitment from ArcLight, and later stated that it had grown to more than 60 employees with thousands of EVs on the road. Its footprint is U.S.-focused and tied to commercial fleet use cases rather than passenger retail charging alone. ArcLight backed the launch in November 2021 and Macquarie Asset Management and Ferrovial later provided additional capital in 2024, while public sources do not disclose the detailed ownership percentages.

afterImage.name: Inspiration Mobility Group
afterImage.description: Inspiration Mobility Group is a Washington, D.C.-headquartered sustainable infrastructure platform that finances, owns, develops and operates commercial electric-vehicle fleets, charging systems and related energy assets across North America. Its operating businesses include Inspiration Fleet and Inspiration Energy. ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII launched the platform in 2021 with an initial $200 million commitment; Macquarie Asset Management and Ferrovial supplied a further $215 million of capital that closed in May 2022. Current company and investor materials identify ArcLight, Macquarie and Ferrovial as continuing investors, while their exact ownership percentages and Macquarie and Ferrovial investment vehicles are not publicly disclosed. Select Electrada assets acquired in June 2026 were integrated into Inspiration Energy and are not counted as a separate PortCo. No Inspiration-specific sale or pending ownership transfer was identified through August 13, 2026.
